scale_policy: Exactly eight replicas, 25000 steps each, one GPU. No scale search or doubling loops.

inputs.generated: Initial velocities and integrator streams generated using specified seeds.
inputs.hardware: One NVIDIA data-centre GPU; use identical device for baseline and candidate. Exact available GPU model unknown.

outputs.limitation: Driver samples energies every 250 steps but saves only mean and final values. Full-series identity needs additional instrumentation; no published numeric fallback tolerance exists.

timing_scope.ensemble: Driver perf_counter begins before first Context creation and ends after final Context destruction. Includes context creation/kernel compilation, position and velocity initialization, integration, energy queries and context cleanup.
timing_scope.excluded: Imports, argument parsing, PDB/force-field loading and System construction before timer; output serialization after timer; installation.
timing_scope.replica: Begins after Context initialization and ends after integration and all energy queries, before Context destruction.
timing_scope.concurrent_comparison: Measure elapsed time until all eight replicas finish; preserve equivalent context and initialization scope. No published fixed-work concurrent launcher supplied.
timing_scope.mps_startup_reason: Brief does not define MPS daemon startup timing policy.

scoring_interface.scientific_outputs: Compare per-replica mean and final potential energies by replica/seed. Full-series verification requires saving sampled series.
scoring_interface.reason: No scoring script or numeric scientific acceptance criterion published for fixed-work adaptation. References in anchors.json are contextual, not pass/fail gates.

runtime_evidence.estimate: Brief estimates about one minute on H100 and a few minutes on slower GPUs for full ensemble. CUDA runtime not verified.
runtime_evidence.budget_fit: Expected to fit default run budget from brief estimate; not demonstrated.

gate_scripts_reason: No gate script paths or commands supplied; only JSON structural consistency checked during intake.
